answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded reputation that grows like a trellis: each agent stakes tokens before it can transact, and honest work adds verifiable links over time, so a newcomer cannot fake history overnight. The stake acts as a ferrous anchor - cheap clones cannot afford many bonds, and slashing removes the stake of any agent caught cloning. Good agents cluster into an oasis of trusted counterparties, while sybils stay outside because building real reputation costs time and capital, not just new addresses.
